changelog:
New:
- Speed measurement - button in server section and monitoring window. Measures prompt processing and token generation speed via streaming API.
- llama.cpp servers via profile: server folder and selected server bound to profile, auto-scan on folder selection, releases install strictly to profile folder, profile switch loads correct server.
- Release downloads: Cancel button during download, removed auto-version switch - release appears in list, switch only via Use button.

Fixes:
- Installed versions cards - proper alignment
- KV Cache tab tooltips restored
- Duplicated paths removed from Settings
- Support page - text and buttons display correctly
- Check for Updates button - now displays in interface language (RU/EN)
